description: Abstract base controller for handling two-factor authentication processes in OrchardCore.Users module, including managing recovery codes, enabling/disabling 2FA, and redirecting users appropriately.

classes.name: TwoFactorAuthenticationBaseController
classes.description: Abstract controller providing common functionality for two-factor authentication workflows in OrchardCore.Users.

methods.name: SetRecoveryCodesAsync
methods.description: Stores recovery codes in distributed cache with a short expiration.

methods.name: RemoveTwoFactorProviderAsync
methods.description: Removes a two-factor provider from a user, with checks for the last provider and required 2FA.

methods.name: EnableTwoFactorAuthenticationAsync
methods.description: Enables 2FA for a user and refreshes claims if required.

methods.name: RefreshTwoFactorClaimAsync
methods.description: Removes existing 2FA claim and refreshes user sign-in.

methods.name: RedirectToTwoFactorAsync
methods.description: Redirects user to 2FA recovery codes or index based on recovery code availability.

methods.name: GetTwoFactorProvidersAsync
methods.description: Retrieves valid 2FA providers for a user intersected with configured options.

methods.name: RedirectToAccountLogin
methods.description: Redirects to the account login page.

methods.name: UserNotFound
methods.description: Returns a 404 result if user cannot be loaded.

methods.name: StripToken
methods.description: Removes spaces and dashes from a token string.

methods.name: GetRecoveryCodesCacheKey
methods.description: Generates cache key for recovery codes based on user ID.
